meta.name: Cargo demonstration
meta.description: A tile carries two numbered tokens along a short route.
rules.goal: Load a token to earn one point. Rotate a loaded tile in place or move and rotate it to pass the turn. Both slots must be filled before the final move. The highest score wins.
rules.handoff: In Handoff, you may deliver the first token to the receiving carrier. It moves to the next cell during the transfer. The transfer does not score again.
events.transferred: Cargo transferred to the second carrier
release.current: Demonstrates board zones attached to a carrier.
release.orientation: The carrier rotates with its cargo in place and while moving.
release.handoff: Move one cargo token between slots on two carriers.
